R4E-duck-backcountry-0002.name: Unnamed wetland 190 m S of Crystalline Creek
R4E-duck-backcountry-0002.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).

evidence.t: About 8 wetlands within 2 km (estimate): ducks move between them.
Beside Crystalline Creek: backwater or oxbow (estimate).

flags.t: Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: District 4. Within the 8 a day: 4 northern pintails, 4 canvasbacks, 2 Barrow's or common goldeneyes together, 2 harlequins. Possession 24: 12, 12, 6, 6.

plan: Drive: from Village of Radium Hot Springs, about 85 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 95, Brisco Rd, Bugaboo Creek FSR, Sec 01.
Park: 50.87129, -116.91768, pull off on Sec7 (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 5.4 km W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 1,061 m, about 215 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 420 m E of the spot at 1,409 m (50.88579, -116.98675). Water: Crystalline Creek 20 m N (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-34, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-01, closures 2026-10-16.
R4E-duck-backcountry-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 4-34: about 8,787 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 2.18 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
